faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Brellò

q1.question: What happens if I don't return the umbrella?
q1.answer: There are no penalties or costs! The umbrellas are completely free even if not returned. The service is 100% sponsored. Of course, returning it helps other citizens use it.

q2.question: Do umbrellas resist wind and heavy rain?
q2.answer: Yes! We use professional quality windproof umbrellas, tested to resist gusts up to 80 km/h. Reinforced structure and waterproof fabric guarantee protection even on the most difficult days.

q3.question: What if it doesn't rain for days? What happens to the umbrellas?
q3.answer: The umbrellas remain available at the stations for when they're needed. Many citizens also use them as parasols on sunny days! Plus, sponsors' advertising remains visible even when it's not raining.

q4.question: Can I book an umbrella in advance?
q4.answer: Currently the service works on a "first come, first served" basis. We are developing an app with a booking system for future versions of the service.

q5.question: How are umbrellas cleaned and maintained?
q5.answer: Umbrellas are checked and cleaned weekly by our team. We use ecological disinfectant products and immediately replace damaged ones to always guarantee the best user experience.
